opening.argument: The presentation centers on an unusually large return opportunity while directing viewers to put their own AVAX into a contract. It reports an increase from about $200 to $1,775, instructs viewers to “Send $200 of Avalanche/AVAX to the contract for gas fee for all swaps,” and tells them to call the flashloan function in Remix. The method further describes creating a token whose value is inflated through rapid trading, with that inflated value presented as the source of profit. This combination of an upfront transfer, contract deployment, and claimed multiplier supports the alleged returns scheme, although the available evidence does not establish that the reported return was genuine, reproducible, recoverable, or sustainable.
